premise: One night Starfish sees shooting stars and thinks they are her cousins in the sky; Turtle tells her they are stars of the sky, and she is a star of the sea.
inspiration: The star-gazing tales of folk tradition (the child who wants to touch the stars), turned around: the little one is a star already.
lesson: You don't have to be far away to shine.

en-US.title: Starfish and the Shooting Stars
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] It was night on the beach, and the moon shone on the water. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish couldn't sleep. {starfish:face happy} She was looking up. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] A star went whizzing across the sky! Then another! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:hop x2} Look! My cousins! They're starfish too! {turtle:enter} Turtle came crawling up, slowly. {turtle:face happy} [warmly] Those are stars of the sky, little one. Far, far away. And you… you're a star of the sea. {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live} Starfish waved all five arms at the sky. Goodnight, cousins! {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Seal looked up from the rocks. {seal:face happy} [whispers] Make a wish, said Seal. So they did, all three. {seal:glow 0.3} [long pause] {turtle:live hold} Turtle tucked her head in. {seal:face sleeping} Seal closed her eyes. {starfish:face sleeping} [softly] And Starfish, the littlest star of all, fell asleep under the stars of the sky.

es-ES.title: Estrella y las estrellas fugaces
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.8 45s} [softly] Era de noche en la playa, y la luna brillaba sobre el agua. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella no podía dormir. {starfish:face happy} Estaba mirando hacia arriba. {canvas:shootingstars 0.7 20s} [gasps] ¡Una estrella cruzó el cielo, zas! ¡Y otra! {starfish:face surprised} {starfish:hop x2} ¡Mirad! ¡Mis primas! ¡Son estrellas de mar, como yo! {turtle:enter} Tortuga llegó arrastrándose, despacito. {turtle:face happy} [warmly] Esas son estrellas del cielo, pequeña. Están muy, muy lejos. Y tú… tú eres una estrella del mar. {starfish:sparkle} {starfish:live} Estrella saludó al cielo con sus cinco brazos. ¡Buenas noches, primas! {seal:enter} {seal:go to rocks} Foca levantó la vista desde las rocas. {seal:face happy} [whispers] Pedid un deseo, dijo Foca. Y eso hicieron, las tres. {seal:glow 0.3} [long pause] {turtle:live hold} Tortuga escondió la cabeza. {seal:face sleeping} Foca cerró los ojos. {starfish:face sleeping} [softly] Y Estrella, la estrellita más pequeña de todas, se durmió bajo las estrellas del cielo.

night.prompt: quiet night waves lapping softly on a beach, very calm, realistic field recording
